title: Yabanin secevents OCSF export envelope (v1)
description: Versioned wire schema of the normalized OCSF-aligned export (packet E07-P01). Root is the envelope; records are its $defs.record. Unknown fields are allowed EVERYWHERE and must be ignored by readers (forward compatibility is a packet acceptance criterion; see the W02 versioning artifact). The schema is a declarative subset contract, not a full OCSF class schema: extensions (org_id, identity, evidence, cost, source_event_type, mapped) are documented extensions, and full OCSF conformance is not claimed.

schema_version.description: Export schema version. MUST equal 1 for this schema. The equality gate (missing vs unsupported) is enforced by the code validator (validate.go) with explicit errors; the schema only types the field.

envelope_id.description: Envelope identifier assigned by the exporting connector; unique within the connector's export stream.

issued_at.description: Envelope issue time, epoch milliseconds (OCSF timestamp_t).

records.description: Normalized records; empty only for an explicitly empty export.

attempt.description: Envelope-level delivery-retry counter (E07-P01-W04 semantics; populated since batch B by the writer-side redelivery path — Envelope.Attempt grows once per delivery retry, never per record; see replay.go and the DLQ precedent cited there). The slot stays schema-stable. Third-party v1 producers MUST NOT set it ad hoc: it is writer-side delivery state, not record content; readers treat it as informational.

record.description: One secevents event in the OCSF-aligned export form (Detection Finding 2004). Canonical key order is the record struct declaration order (pkg/ocsf/record.go); JSON objects are unordered, but the canonical encoding is byte-deterministic.

schema_version.description: Export schema version of the record; equals the envelope's schema_version.

activity_id.description: OCSF activity. 1 = Create for mapped types; 0 = Unknown for unmapped types.

severity_id.description: OCSF severity. deny=4 High, mask=3 Medium, flag=2 Low, allow=1 Informational, unmapped=0 Unknown.

org_id.description: Tenant scope of the event, carried verbatim from secevents.

evidence.description: Redacted evidence references: digests only, content cannot be carried by type.

source_event_type.description: Original secevents event_type, always preserved — including for unmapped records.

mapped.description: false = the source type was not in the known mapping table (unmapped discipline); the record is still complete and must not be dropped.

replay_id.description: Replay correlation id (E07-P01-W04; populated since batch B by the writer-side pipeline: ReplayID(org_id, finding_info.uid) — a deterministic derivation filled by AssignReplayIDs before envelope construction, and re-derived and enforced by VerifyEnvelope, ErrReplayIDMismatch on divergence). The slot stays schema-stable. Third-party v1 producers MUST NOT set it ad hoc: the value is derived, and a mismatched value fails verification.

finding_info.description: Subset of the OCSF finding_info object.

uid.description: Dedup anchor: the secevents event_id (deterministically derived).

version.description: Target OCSF release, pinned (e.g. 1.9.0); see the W01 mapping artifact.

secevents_schema_version.description: Source secevents schema version (dual version pinning).

identity.description: secevents tri-state identifier block, carried verbatim: unknown must never collapse into absent or a known value.

idref.description: Typed identifier reference. Default resolution when state is absent: a non-empty value means known, an empty/missing value means absent. An explicit unknown state must not carry a value.

evidence_ref.description: Digest reference to a redacted evidence artifact; there is deliberately no content-bearing field.

digest.description: Lower-case hex SHA-256 of the redacted artifact.

location.description: Optional storage pointer; never a capture (data URLs are rejected upstream).

cost.description: Cost extension. State known ⇒ micro_usd is expected to be present (an explicit 0 means known-free). State unknown ⇒ micro_usd MUST NOT be present (unknown must not collapse into zero). A missing cost object means the event has no cost dimension at all. The state-conditional rule is enforced by the mapper and pinned by tests; expressing it here would need draft 2020-12 conditionals the embedded validator intentionally does not implement.

micro_usd.description: Present iff state is known (pointer-typed in the producer).
